versions.changelog:
Initial skill version for Tartarian WebMCP Operator.

- Enables collaborative operation of the live Tartarian.ai world through Site Tools alongside a human user.
- Provides doctrine for observation, navigation, inventory awareness, resource gathering, interaction, targeting, and Command Bar actions.
- Emphasizes reliance on structured tool results, never inventing world facts or tool capabilities.
- Outlines action families: world interaction vs. Command Bar activation.
- Details proper movement procedures, emphasizing single-tile steps and efficient long-distance travel by chaining moves.
- Establishes observing-before-acting and human collaboration protocols to ensure up-to-date world state.
